name: scamouflage
description: Chrome extension that spots scam and phishing emails and messages on-device with Gemini Nano, using Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference with a privacy-preserving cloud fallback.

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f scamouflage.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../scamouflage.zip . && cd .. && echo "Created scamouflage.zip"
scripts.preview: npm run build -- --mode development && python3 scripts/preview-server.py 5180
scripts.build:web: vite build --config vite.web.config.js --mode web && node scripts/check-web-build.mjs
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting --project scamouflage-37a72
